title: Solid-State Battery Pack for Electric Vehicle with 1000km Range
abstract: A 200 kWh solid-state battery pack (sulfide electrolyte) in cell-to-pack architecture achieving 500 Wh/kg enabling 1000km range with 10-min fast charging.
claims: Li metal anode (50um), Li6PS5Cl electrolyte (30um), NMC811 cathode (100um) at 400 Wh/kg.
Cell-to-pack integration with 85% volume utilization, 500 Wh/kg pack level.
Dielectric fluid immersion thermal management maintaining 25-35C during 10C charging.
problem_statement: Current EV batteries achieve 250 Wh/kg pack level limiting range to 500km.
